description.en: Biography of Yixin Cui, a composer, tenor, multi-instrumentalist, and conductor from Hokkien, based in Rochester, New York.
description.zh: 崔浥新，來自福建、現居紐約州羅切斯特的作曲家、男高音、多樂器演奏者與指揮。

intro.en: (b. 2002) is from Hokkien and currently based in Rochester, New York. They[^pronouns] are a composer, tenor, multi-instrumentalist, and conductor.
intro.zh: （生於 2002 年）來自福建，現居紐約州羅切斯特，是一位作曲家、男高音、多樂器演奏者與指揮。[^pronouns]

body.en:
Cui believes that in a ludic[^ludic] and pharmacopornographic[^pharmacopornographic] century, their generation powerlessly faces a teleologically relentless Whig-party world, in which the ancient world has never been so defamiliarized. They thus confront the millennial expectation with privately metaphorized queertopian[^queertopian] ancient allegories that are trolling, abjectly poised and childishly frivolous materials in an almost Apollonian form. Cui uses the term *Gesamtkuns-Twerk* to describe some of their works [(Read *Twink Death*)](/works/twink-death/).

The philosophy of Cui’s composition reflects their interests in linguistics, classical philology [(Read *Saijōtai Yamata[i]-K[h]itan No. 2*)](/works/saijotai-yamatai-khitan-no-2/), anthropology, religions, medical humanities, art history and history [(Read *Impasse of the Weasels*)](/works/impasse-of-the-weasels/). Cui’s music is deeply influenced by their ethnomusicological interests, especially their research into the performance and instrument-making of early Silk Road music [(Read *Bayanbulak*)](/works/bayanbulak/) from the 11th century BC to the 17th century AD, for solo instruments [(Read *Wasserlenken.*)](/works/wasserlenken/), operas, court music [(Read *Phalanx Break*)](/works/phalanx-break/), and vocal traditions [(Read *DU, nouvelle prière bouddhique*)](/works/du-nouvelle-priere-bouddhique/).

After graduating from [Swarthmore College](https://www.swarthmore.edu/) with a BA in Philosophy in 2025, Cui is at the beginning stage of a career as a professional composer. They studied with [Gerald Levinson](https://geraldlevinson.com/), [Thomas Whitman](https://twhitman.com/), and [Erin Busch](https://www.erinbusch.com/), and currently study with [Daniel Pesca](https://www.danielpesca.com/) at the [Eastman School of Music](https://www.esm.rochester.edu/) in an MA program in composition.[^teachers] So far, they have collaborated with the [Jasper String Quartet](https://www.jasperquartet.com/), [Relâche Ensemble](https://www.relachemusic.org/about), [American Choral Directors Association](https://www.acdapa.org/), [American Guild of Organists](https://www.agophila.org/), [Hannah Rose Nicholas](https://www.hannahroseviola.com/), [Passacaglia Chamber Music Collective](https://westsidemusicfoundation.org/passacaglia/), [Swarthmore Orchestra](https://www.swarthmore.edu/music/swarthmore-college-orchestra), [Garnet Singers](https://www.swarthmore.edu/music/swarthmore-college-chorus-garnet-singers), and [Fetter Music Program](https://www.swarthmore.edu/news-events/fetterfest-marks-50-years-chamber-music-swarthmore). They were selected to work with [Roderick Williams OBE](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roderick_Williams), [Mark Loria](https://www.swarthmore.edu/music/mark-loria), [Damin Spritzer](https://www.daminspritzer.com/), and [Anton Armstrong](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anton_Armstrong) on composition, voice, organ and choral conducting. As a concert musician, they have often been commissioned to perform new compositions. They were awarded [Freeman Scholars](https://www.swarthmore.edu/sites/default/files/assets/documents/registrar/2015-16_Catalog.pdf.pdf) in 2024 and the [Hannah A. Leedom Fellowship](https://careercenter.swarthmore.edu/resources/swarthmore-fellowships/) in 2026 for their talents in voice and composition.[^repertoire]

Outside of music, Cui is a professional illustrator and enjoys translating and writing [(Read *Blog*)](/writings/).

[^as-of]: As of October, 2026.
[^pronouns]: They use any pronouns.
[^ludic]: Eric Zimmerman, “[Manifesto for a Ludic Century](https://www.ericzimmerman.com/assets/pdfs/Manifesto_for_a_Ludic_Century.pdf),” in *The Gameful World: Approaches, Issues, Applications*, ed. Steffen P. Walz and Sebastian Deterding (MIT Press, 2015), 19–22.
[^pharmacopornographic]: Paul B. Preciado, [*Testo Junkie: Sex, Drugs, and Biopolitics in the Pharmacopornographic Era*](https://feministpress.org/products/9781558618374-testo-junkie), trans. Bruce Benderson (Feminist Press, 2013).
[^queertopian]: José Esteban Muñoz, [*Cruising Utopia: The Then and There of Queer Futurity*](https://nyupress.org/9781479874569/cruising-utopia-10th-anniversary-edition/), 10th anniversary ed. (New York University Press, 2019).
[^teachers]: [Read *C.V.* for teachers in voice, instruments and conducting.](/cv/#cv-teachers)
[^repertoire]: [Read *C.V.* for selected performance repertoire.](/cv/#cv-repertoire)
body.zh: 崔浥新認為，在一個遊戲的[^ludic]與藥物色情的[^pharmacopornographic]世紀，其世代無力地面對一個目的論永不停歇的輝格式世界；在這樣的世界中，古代從未如此陌生化。因此，崔以私人隱喻化的、指向酷兒烏托邦[^queertopian]的古代寓言，對峙新千年的期待：這些充滿戲弄、卑賤而從容、幼稚而輕佻的材料，被置於近乎阿波羅式的形式之中。崔以 *Gesamtkuns-Twerk* 一詞形容其中一些作品 [（閱讀 *菊花殘*）](/works/twink-death/)。 崔的作曲哲學反映出對語言學、古典語文學 [（閱讀 *罪狀體邪馬臺綺譚 其二*）](/works/saijotai-yamatai-khitan-no-2/)、人類學、宗教、醫學人文、藝術史與歷史的興趣 [（閱讀 *鼬ノ困*）](/works/impasse-of-the-weasels/)。其音樂深受民族音樂學興趣影響，尤其是對公元前十一世紀至公元十七世紀早期絲綢之路音樂的演奏與樂器製作研究 [（閱讀 *巴音布魯克*）](/works/bayanbulak/)，涵蓋獨奏樂器 [（閱讀 *疏導法*）](/works/wasserlenken/)、歌劇、宮廷音樂 [（閱讀 *破陣*）](/works/phalanx-break/)與聲樂傳統 [（閱讀 *妳度：古代佛教祈禱*）](/works/du-nouvelle-priere-bouddhique/)。 2025 年，崔自[斯沃斯莫爾學院](https://www.swarthmore.edu/)取得哲學文學士學位，正處於職業作曲家生涯的起步階段。曾隨 [Gerald Levinson](https://geraldlevinson.com/)、[Thomas Whitman](https://twhitman.com/) 與 [Erin Busch](https://www.erinbusch.com/) 學習，目前於[伊斯曼音樂學院](https://www.esm.rochester.edu/)作曲碩士課程隨 [Daniel Pesca](https://www.danielpesca.com/) 學習。[^teachers]迄今合作對象包括 [Jasper String Quartet](https://www.jasperquartet.com/)、[Relâche Ensemble](https://www.relachemusic.org/about)、[American Choral Directors Association](https://www.acdapa.org/)、[American Guild of Organists](https://www.agophila.org/)、[Hannah Rose Nicholas](https://www.hannahroseviola.com/)、[Passacaglia Chamber Music Collective](https://westsidemusicfoundation.org/passacaglia/)、[Swarthmore Orchestra](https://www.swarthmore.edu/music/swarthmore-college-orchestra)、[Garnet Singers](https://www.swarthmore.edu/music/swarthmore-college-chorus-garnet-singers) 與 [Fetter Music Program](https://www.swarthmore.edu/news-events/fetterfest-marks-50-years-chamber-music-swarthmore)。曾獲選與 [Roderick Williams OBE](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roderick_Williams)、[Mark Loria](https://www.swarthmore.edu/music/mark-loria)、[Damin Spritzer](https://www.daminspritzer.com/) 及 [Anton Armstrong](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anton_Armstrong) 在作曲、聲樂、管風琴及合唱指揮領域交流。作為音樂會演奏者，亦常受委約演出新作。憑藉聲樂與作曲方面的才能，於 2024 年獲頒 [Freeman Scholars](https://www.swarthmore.edu/sites/default/files/assets/documents/registrar/2015-16_Catalog.pdf.pdf)，並於 2026 年獲頒 [Hannah A. Leedom Fellowship](https://careercenter.swarthmore.edu/resources/swarthmore-fellowships/)。[^repertoire] 音樂之外，崔是一位職業插畫師，亦喜愛翻譯與寫作 [（閱讀 *網誌*）](/writings/)。 [^as-of]: 截至 2026 年 10 月。 [^pronouns]: 不限定人稱代詞（any pronouns）。 [^ludic]: Eric Zimmerman, “[Manifesto for a Ludic Century](https://www.ericzimmerman.com/assets/pdfs/Manifesto_for_a_Ludic_Century.pdf),” in *The Gameful World: Approaches, Issues, Applications*, ed.
